follow-up time: Until death or discharge from the hospital
cohort: 1015 hypertensive pregnant women who gave birth between 2008 and 2013 in three university teaching hospitals
finding: Parity, gestational age, type and onset of HDP, mode of delivery, birth weight, and maternal outcome were strong predictors of perinatal mortality in hypertensive pregnant women.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was an independent predictor of perinatal mortality in women with HDP (OR, 5.3; 95% CI, 2.93-9.54).
gest_age: Preterm and very preterm gestational age
